name: Dornoll

attributes.attribute: daughter of Domnall Míldemail, king of Scotland
loved Cúchulainn, who spurned her in favor of Scáthach

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Dornoll, also Dornolla, was an Irish heroine. She was the daughter of Domnall Míldemail, king of Scotland. She was powerful but unattractive. She was a druid and a warrior woman. She fell in love with the hero Cúchulainn. He spurned her. He chose to study with Scáthach, another Scottish amazon.
objective: Records Dornoll, a Scottish druid and warrior woman who loved Cúchulainn but was spurned.
